meanings.tr: enkaz, kaza sonucu harap olmuş araç/gemi
meanings.en: a vehicle or ship that has been badly damaged or destroyed
meanings.exampleEn: Divers explored the wreck of the old ship at the bottom of the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Dalgıçlar denizin dibindeki eski geminin enkazını keşfetti.

meanings.en: in a way that is incorrect or unjust
meanings.exampleEn: He was wrongly accused of stealing the money.

meanings.en: a photograph of the inside of the body made using radiation
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor took an X-ray to check if the bone was broken.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor kemiğin kırık olup olmadığını kontrol etmek için bir röntgen çekti.

meanings.en: a large boat used for racing or pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: They sailed around the islands on a luxury yacht.
meanings.exampleTr: Lüks bir yatla adaların etrafında yelken açtılar.

meanings.en: an act of opening the mouth wide because of tiredness or boredom
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to hide a yawn during the long meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun toplantı sırasında bir esnemeyi gizlemeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: to have a strong feeling of wanting something
meanings.exampleEn: After years abroad, she began to yearn for her homeland.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca yurt dışında kaldıktan sonra memleketini özlemeye başladı.

meanings.en: having the freshness or energy of a young person
meanings.exampleEn: Despite her age, she has a youthful appearance.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşına rağmen genç bir görünüşü var.

meanings.exampleEn: This chocolate cake is absolutely yummy.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu çikolatalı kek gerçekten çok lezzetli.

meanings.en: an African wild animal like a horse with black and white stripes
meanings.exampleEn: We saw a herd of zebra grazing on the savanna.
meanings.exampleTr: Savanada otlayan bir zebra sürüsü gördük.

meanings.en: a fastener with two rows of teeth joined by a sliding tab
meanings.exampleEn: The zip on my jacket is broken and won't close.

meanings.en: the act of making a subject appear closer using a camera lens
meanings.exampleEn: Use the zoom on your camera to capture the bird in detail.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuşu ayrıntılı yakalamak için kameranın zumunu kullan.
